messages:
Noah (PM): Quick sync on API keys UX — test users keep clicking Copy then accidentally hitting Revoke. Need safer defaults + clearer copy.
Lina (Design): Thinking: separate primary actions visually. Keep Copy as primary, but change Revoke to an icon-only action inside an overflow and add a label on hover. Also propose a small safety pill: 'Protected' for keys tied to infra.
DeShawn (Frontend): Overflow + icon okay. But icon-only hurts discovery on mobile. On small screens maybe show an explicit '...' menu that opens an action sheet.
Mei (Accessibility): For icon-only actions, ensure each icon has aria-label and visible focus ring. Action sheet must be announced with role=\"dialog\" and a descriptive heading.
Rafael (Backend): On revoke semantics: we currently support soft-delete with 10m restoration and full purge after. If UX requires a longer undo, we can extend TTL but need to coordinate retention/audit.
Noah (PM): Product preference is to keep soft-undo but surface it in the UI: show an undo toast and a 'recently revoked' panel in the console for admins. Suggest 2-minute visibility in UI (backend still keeps 10m).
Lina (Design): UI idea: after revoke show a persistent small banner \"Key disabled — undo (2m)\" with countdown. For bulk revokes, require typing the word \"REVOKE\" and show estimated number of affected services.
DeShawn (Frontend): Typing confirmation for bulk is fine. For single-item revoke, prefer simple confirm modal with a required checkbox \"I understand this will stop services using this key.\" Avoid extra typing.
Mei (Accessibility): If we do the countdown, it must be programmatically cancellable and the toast should be reachable via keyboard. Also read out remaining time periodically is not great for screen readers; better to provide a simple statement \"Undo available for 2 minutes.\"
Rafael (Backend): Note: adding recent-revoked panel implies we keep mapping of old keys to users for at least 24h for audit — ops flagged this. Will open ticket to align retention with compliance.
Noah (PM): Copy: rather than 'Revoke' or 'Disable', we tested 'Disable key' and it lowered perceived severity. But legal/regulatory docs use 'Revoke'. Risk of mismatch. Proposal: use 'Disable' in UI and show a short descriptor: 'Disables key (can undo for 2m). This will be logged as a revoke in audit records.'
Lina (Design): Also proposing microcopy for empty state: if user has no keys show CTA 'Create key' plus subtext 'Admins can create keys; contact your org admin' when they lack perms. Include link to request access flow.
Mei (Accessibility): Ensure disabled CTA still has focusable explanatory text in DOM (screen readers can't reach tooltips). Provide an accessible link to request access.
DeShawn (Frontend): Row layout: add a small secondary line for 'Last used' meaning: 'Last used for inference or management API.' We should also add a hover card showing first/last used and created date to help debug.
Noah (PM): AuditBot: any changes that surface audit stuff should trigger a compliance ticket.
AuditBot: Reminder: create compliance ticket C-421 if UI reveals revoked key content or retention windows.
Rafael (Backend): Quick feasibility: adding undo banner + recent-revoked panel is backend-minor. Bulk-typing confirm needs rate-limiting.
Lina (Design): Action items: I'll upload updated mocks with mobile and desktop variants, include banner and panel.
Mei (Accessibility): I'll create an a11y checklist for the new components (banner, panel, action sheet, bulk modal).
DeShawn (Frontend): I'll estimate work once mocks are posted.
Noah (PM): Thanks team — please drop links to mocks and ticket numbers in this thread.
